content: sam_itr_queryi (10 lines) wraps hts_itr_query (150 lines of bin-based index lookup). sam_itr_querys (7 lines) adds name→tid resolution (already Rust via HeaderView.tid()). The core algorithm: given a genomic region [beg, end), find all BAI bins that overlap, collect their virtual offsets, and return an iterator that seeks to each offset. Depends on: pure Rust BAI index (#70).
